_help: The Receipts Archive. Chat greatest hits, quotes of the week and bold predictions are pulled automatically from every issue. Add extra hot takes from the chat log here: {season, who, text, context, date, tags, status, note, used_in}. status: aged_well | aged_badly | pending. used_in: optional list of issue numbers that already ran it (shows a 'Used in Issue N' badge). who must be an exact handle. Never paraphrase: paste the line as written.
